initiative.title: ShopPilot MVP — single-merchant B2C storefront + back office
initiative.summary: A single-merchant Thai-market online shop covering the full business flow (browse -> cart -> checkout -> pay -> fulfil -> review) plus an admin back office. Governance is pre-resolved: Legal Counsel, DPO and Compliance are named and engaged; PII inventory, retention, residency and regulatory citations (PDPA, Revenue Code, CPA, PCI-DSS) are resolved, and every numeric policy parameter carries a named approving owner.

per_epic_tier.justification: Customer-facing authentication handling PII (email/phone) with resolved PDPA lawful basis; no AML/sanctions/regulated-activity content -> T2, not T1.
Customer-facing money path, but mock payment with no cardholder data stored (PSP-tokenized, PCI scope-excluded); resolved citations -> T2.
Customer-facing order data with own-data-only isolation and audited state machine; standard PII -> T2.
Back-office stock with audit trail and concurrency-safety; no PII, no regulated activity -> T2 (operational integrity).

epics.title: Customer authentication and session management
epics.problem_statement: Customers cannot securely access their own account, cart and order history without an authentication boundary; every authenticated storefront path depends on this, and credential handling must satisfy PDPA lawful basis and leak no PII.
epics.why_now: Auth is the prerequisite for checkout, orders and reviews; nothing customer-specific can ship before it.
epics.hypothesis: A short-lived access token plus a rotating refresh token gives a secure, low-friction session that unblocks the rest of the storefront.

success_criteria.metric: login success rate on valid credentials

tier_signals.evidence_quote: Register with email, password, name, phone. Email is unique; weak passwords rejected

tier_signals.signal: resolved PDPA lawful basis, no AML/sanctions
tier_signals.evidence_quote: Lawful basis cited to Thailand PDPA B.E. 2562 (2019)

story_refs.title: Customer logs in with email and password
Customer refreshes an expired session securely

epics.title: Server-side checkout and mock payment
epics.problem_statement: Customers must be able to pay for a cart at a total the system computes (never a tampered client value), with shipping and coupon rules applied, and the order must not double-charge or oversell when clicks or provider callbacks are duplicated.
epics.why_now: Checkout is the revenue path; it depends on auth and gates orders and inventory.
epics.hypothesis: Server-computed totals plus idempotent confirm and provider-replay dedup give a correct, replay-safe money path on a mock provider that swaps cleanly for a real PSP later.

tier_signals.evidence_quote: All money is computed server-side - the client total is never trusted
card data (PAN/CVV) is never collected or stored by ShopPilot

story_refs.title: Customer checks out at a server-computed total
Mock payment capture with provider-replay safety

epics.title: Orders, fulfillment and price snapshot
epics.problem_statement: Customers must be able to track only their own order through a state machine with a frozen price snapshot, and admins must advance fulfillment with no illegal backward transitions, every change audited.
epics.why_now: Orders are the post-payment customer experience and the admin's daily work; they depend on checkout.
epics.hypothesis: An append-only audited state machine plus an order-time price/name/address snapshot gives trustworthy tracking that never drifts with catalog edits.

tier_signals.signal: customer PII shown with own-data-only isolation
tier_signals.evidence_quote: A customer sees only their own data - never another customer's orders or addresses

story_refs.title: Customer tracks an order with a frozen price snapshot
Admin advances the fulfillment state machine

epics.title: Stock reservation and audit
epics.problem_statement: Stock must never oversell or go negative under concurrent checkouts, reservations must release on failure/timeout/cancel, and every admin stock change must be audited with a reason and before/after values.
epics.why_now: Inventory integrity underpins checkout correctness and the no-oversell reliability promise.
epics.hypothesis: Reserve-on-confirm with a TTL release plus an audited adjustment log gives correct stock under races without holding inventory at add-to-cart.

tier_signals.evidence_quote: Stock may never go negative - concurrent last-item checkouts must resolve to exactly one winner

stories.title: Customer logs in with email and password

card.i_want: to log in with my email and password
card.so_that: I can access my profile, cart and orders securely

stories.context: Authentication boundary for the storefront; credentials are PII under PDPA and the failure message must not enable account enumeration.

given: a registered customer with valid credentials
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer submits a login request
then: a 15-minute access token and a 14-day refresh token are issued
no password or token value appears in any log

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: wrong password is indistinguishable from unknown email
given: a registered customer
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer submits a wrong password
then: the request is rejected with the generic message 'email or password is incorrect'
the same message is returned for an unknown email

given: any login attempt
acceptance_criteria.when: the attempt resolves
then: an audit event is emitted carrying {event, actor, ts, outcome, audit_id} with no credential value

pii_fields.justification: email and phone are direct PII; password is a credential
pii_fields.treatment: encrypt at rest; one-way hash for password; redact in logs

audit_events.justification: login attempts must be auditable for security review

idempotency.justification: login is an authn read with no state mutation to replay

reversibility.justification: issuing a session has nothing to reverse

authn_authz.justification: this story is the authentication boundary itself

regulatory.justification: PDPA B.E. 2562 sec. 24 lawful basis for credential handling; citation resolved

tipping_off.justification: no SAR/AML context in an e-commerce login

stories.title: Customer refreshes an expired session securely

card.so_that: I stay logged in without re-entering credentials and without weakening security

stories.context: Refresh-token rotation must be atomic and replay-resistant so a stolen or duplicated refresh token cannot mint extra sessions.

given: a valid, unexpired refresh token
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer requests a refresh
then: a new access+refresh pair is issued
the previous refresh token is revoked

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: replayed refresh token revokes the family
given: a refresh token that was already used
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer presents it again
then: the request is rejected
the entire token family is revoked

given: two simultaneous refresh requests with the same token
acceptance_criteria.when: both are processed
then: exactly one rotation occurs
only one new pair is issued; the other request fails closed

given: any refresh
acceptance_criteria.when: it resolves
then: an audit event with {event, actor, ts, outcome, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: operates on opaque tokens, not PII

audit_events.justification: refresh and revocation are security events

idempotency.justification: rotation must be atomic so concurrent refreshes cannot double-issue

reversibility.justification: rotation is forward-only; revocation is the safety control

regulatory.justification: no regulated data beyond the credential already covered in AUTH-01

stories.title: Customer checks out at a server-computed total

card.i_want: to review my cart, address, coupon, shipping and net total before paying
card.so_that: I pay exactly what the system computed, not a tampered client value

stories.context: Totals are computed server-side; shipping is free at >= 1500 THB else 60 THB; one coupon, floored at 0; the coupon is re-validated at confirm and a double-click yields exactly one order.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: server-computed total with coupon and shipping
given: a cart subtotal of 1200 THB with coupon WELCOME100 (-100) and an in-region address
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer confirms the order
then: the server computes total = 1160 THB (1200 - 100 + 60 shipping)
an order is created in awaiting-payment with reserved stock

given: a coupon that expired while the customer browsed
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer confirms
then: the order is rejected with the neutral message 'this coupon is no longer valid'
no order is created and no stock is reserved

given: a confirm already accepted for this idempotency key
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer clicks confirm again
then: the original order is returned
no second order, reservation or charge is created

given: any confirm that creates an order
acceptance_criteria.when: it resolves
then: an audit event {event, actor, ts, order_id, total, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: the chosen shipping address is direct PII
pii_fields.treatment: snapshotted into the order; redacted in non-order logs

audit_events.justification: order creation is a financial event

idempotency.justification: double-click must not create duplicate orders/charges

reversibility.justification: a confirm that fails downstream must release reserved stock
reversibility.compensating_action: release the stock reserved by this confirm

authn_authz.justification: the cart and address must belong to the confirming customer

regulatory.justification: Consumer Protection Act / Electronic Transactions Act require the total be shown before payment; resolved

stories.title: Mock payment capture with provider-replay safety

card.i_want: to pay for my awaiting-payment order through the mock provider
card.so_that: my order is confirmed and stock is settled exactly once

stories.context: Three mock outcomes (success/failure/timeout); the captured amount must equal the server total; a duplicate provider callback must apply only once.

given: an awaiting-payment order with reserved stock
acceptance_criteria.when: the mock provider returns success with an amount equal to the server total
then: the order moves to paid
reserved stock converts to sold
a shipment record and a 'payment succeeded' notification are written

given: an awaiting-payment order with reserved stock
acceptance_criteria.when: the mock provider returns failure or timeout
then: the order moves to payment-failed or payment-timeout
the reserved stock is released back to available

given: a payment-confirmation already applied for a provider event id
acceptance_criteria.when: the same event id is received again
then: the order is unchanged
stock is not decremented again and the amount is unchanged

given: any capture attempt
acceptance_criteria.when: it resolves
then: an audit event {event, actor, ts, order_id, amount, outcome, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: no cardholder data is collected or stored; the PSP tokenizes (PCI scope-excluded)

idempotency.justification: provider callbacks can be re-sent and must apply once

reversibility.justification: a failed/timed-out capture must release the reservation
reversibility.compensating_action: release reserved stock and mark payment-failed/timeout

authn_authz.justification: only the order owner may pay

regulatory.justification: PCI-DSS v4.0 scope boundary confirmed: no PAN stored; citation resolved

stories.title: Customer tracks an order with a frozen price snapshot

card.i_want: to view my order's status, timeline and frozen prices
card.so_that: I can track delivery and see what I actually agreed to pay

stories.context: An order shows a price/name/address snapshot taken at creation and is visible only to its owner; later catalog edits must not change it.

given: a customer who owns order ORD-20260507-000001 created at price 1290 THB
acceptance_criteria.when: the catalog price later changes to 999 THB and the owner opens the order
then: the order still shows 1290 THB
the status timeline and tracking number (if shipped) are shown

given: a customer who does not own the order
acceptance_criteria.when: they request the order by its number
then: access is denied with no order data disclosed

given: any order status change
acceptance_criteria.when: it resolves
then: an audit event {event, actor, ts, order_id, before, after, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: the order carries the customer's snapshotted shipping address
pii_fields.treatment: visible to the owner and admin only; redacted elsewhere

idempotency.justification: viewing an order is a read with no mutation

reversibility.justification: a read has nothing to reverse

authn_authz.justification: own-data-only: A must never see B's order

regulatory.justification: covered by PDPA basis already inventoried; no new regulated processing here

stories.title: Admin advances the fulfillment state machine

card.i_want: to move a paid order through packing, shipped and delivered
card.so_that: customers can track fulfillment and the history stays correct

stories.context: Transitions are forward-only (paid->packing->shipped[tracking required]->delivered); illegal backward moves are rejected and every transition is audited with the actor.

given: a paid order
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin moves it to packing then shipped with a tracking number then delivered
then: each transition is accepted
the shipped transition is rejected if the tracking number is blank

given: a shipped order
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin tries to move it back to packing or to cancel a delivered order
then: the transition is rejected
the order status is unchanged

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: re-submitting the same transition is idempotent
given: an order already moved to shipped
acceptance_criteria.when: the same shipped transition is submitted again
then: no duplicate state change occurs
no duplicate audit/notification is produced

given: any accepted transition
acceptance_criteria.when: it resolves
then: an audit event {event, actor, ts, order_id, before, after, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: the admin operates on order ids and statuses; customer PII view is limited and inventoried in ORDER-01

audit_events.justification: each transition must record the acting admin and before/after

idempotency.justification: a re-submitted transition must not double-apply

reversibility.justification: illegal backward transitions are rejected; admin cancel-before-packing releases stock
reversibility.compensating_action: reject illegal transitions; release stock on admin cancel before packing

authn_authz.justification: only admin role may transition orders

regulatory.justification: internal fulfillment operation, no regulated processing

stories.title: Stock reservation lifecycle and last-item race

card.i_want: my checkout to reserve stock atomically with a TTL
card.so_that: two of us cannot both succeed on the last unit and stock never goes negative

stories.context: Reserve on confirm (not add-to-cart); a 30-minute TTL auto-releases; payment converts to sold; failure/timeout/cancel releases; concurrent last-item checkouts yield exactly one winner.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: reserve on confirm and auto-release on TTL
given: a product with 1 unit available
acceptance_criteria.when: a customer confirms and does not pay within 30 minutes
then: the unit is reserved at confirm
the reservation auto-releases back to available after the TTL

given: a product with 1 unit available and two simultaneous confirms
acceptance_criteria.when: both customers confirm at nearly the same time
then: exactly one confirm succeeds
the other is rejected with an out-of-stock error at confirm, not at payment
available stock never goes negative

given: a reservation already taken for a confirm
acceptance_criteria.when: the reserve operation is retried for the same confirm
then: only one reservation exists
available stock is decremented once

given: any reserve or release
acceptance_criteria.when: it resolves
then: an audit event {event, actor, ts, sku, before, after, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: stock counts carry no personal data

audit_events.justification: reservations and releases change sellable inventory and are audited

idempotency.justification: a retried reserve/release must apply once

reversibility.justification: release is the compensating action for unpaid/failed/cancelled holds
reversibility.compensating_action: release reserved units on TTL, payment failure/timeout, or cancel-before-pay

authn_authz.justification: reservations are system-driven and scoped to the confirming customer's order

regulatory.justification: operational stock integrity, no regulated processing

stories.title: Admin adjusts stock with an audit trail

card.i_want: to adjust a SKU's stock with a mandatory reason
card.so_that: physical counts stay correct and every change is traceable

stories.context: Admin may receive/count/write-off stock but must give a reason and may not reduce available below the currently reserved quantity; each change is audited with before/after.

given: a SKU with 10 available and 2 reserved
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin sets available to 12 with reason 'received from supplier'
then: available becomes 12
an audit entry records actor, reason and before/after

given: a SKU with 5 available and 3 reserved
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin tries to set available to 2
then: the adjustment is rejected because it would drop below the reserved quantity
stock is unchanged

given: any accepted adjustment
acceptance_criteria.when: it resolves
then: an audit event {event, actor, ts, sku, reason, before, after, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: stock adjustments carry no personal data

audit_events.justification: manual stock changes must be fully attributable

idempotency.justification: each manual adjustment is a distinct intentional entry, not a replayed event

reversibility.justification: a wrong adjustment is corrected by a new audited adjustment, not an in-place reversal

authn_authz.justification: only admin role may adjust stock

open_questions.question: Should a customer be able to confirm delivery, or does the admin mark delivered (current design)?
open_questions.why_matters: Adding customer-confirmed delivery introduces a new flow and a notification; it is deferred but affects ORDER scope if pulled forward.

open_questions.question: What is the abandoned-cart handling beyond the 30-day purge (notify vs silent purge)?
open_questions.why_matters: Affects the cart-abandonment KPI and a possible future reminder notification; not blocking for MVP.

assumptions_made.why_made: Frame-4 authority-notification sub-topic; owners are named in the doc.

glossary.definition: Thailand's personal-data-protection statute governing lawful basis, retention, residency and data-subject rights.
A client- or provider-supplied token ensuring a repeated request applies its effect at most once.
A time-limited hold placed on inventory at checkout-confirm that converts to sold on payment or releases on failure/timeout/cancel.
Price/name/SKU/address copied into an order at creation so later catalog edits do not change a placed order.

pii_inventory.treatment: encrypt at rest; redact in logs
pii_inventory.retention_rule: 5 years after last order (Revenue Code envelope)
pii_inventory.masking_rule: show domain only in admin lists

pii_inventory.treatment: encrypt at rest; redact in logs
one-way hash only; never logged or returned

ba_reasoning_trace.why_epic_boundary: Split into four workstreams along user-value and state-machine boundaries: authentication, money/checkout, order fulfillment, and inventory integrity. Each has >= 2 acceptance-bearing capabilities and a distinct owner, satisfying multi-epic criteria without tech-layer splitting.
ba_reasoning_trace.why_story_decomposition: Stories follow workflow steps and happy-vs-error/race paths (e.g. checkout total vs payment capture; reservation lifecycle vs admin adjustment), keeping each INVEST-small while preserving the banking-grade scenarios (idempotency, audit, reversibility).
best_practices_applied: idempotency-replay AC on every state-change story (FM-16)
deviations: story_points sized by BA (not left TBD_by_TL) because the gold input is fully resolved, allowing a met Definition of Ready

processing_metadata.parsing_reason: the gold doc is well-structured markdown prose with explicit governance sections

frames_skipped_reasons.3: money is bounded to a mock provider with no real settlement, economics decisions are out of MVP scope
frames_skipped_reasons.7: the only external systems are mock payment/courier providers explicitly stubbed for MVP
frames_skipped_reasons.8: single market and single language are fixed for MVP; full localization is deferred
